model.name: Suppress OS keyboard + configurable Keyboard Controller shell
model.description: An action that PREVENTS the OS (iOS) keyboard from opening on terminal input, plus a keyboard-controller surface (like the action bar) with CONFIGURABLE, data-driven keystrokes. This sprint delivers the suppression + the controller shell + the config model; the full controller is designed later.
model.tronQuote: an action that PREVENTS the OS keyboard from opening, plus a keyboard-controller surface like the action bar but with CONFIGURABLE KEYSTROKES (full controller designed later — this sprint = suppression + shell + config model)

acceptanceCriteria.text: Firing the action means the iOS keyboard NEVER opens on terminal input (suppressed by construction, not dismissed after).
The terminal stays FULLY VISIBLE — it is currently 100% occluded by the keyboard; after the action it is not occluded.
The keyboard-controller input row must NOT overlay the Scenario/Edit buttons.
Keystrokes are CONFIGURABLE (data-driven config model, not hardcoded) — the config model exists and drives the controller shell.
Gated @390 REAL-WebKit with a SCREENSHOT: pixel evidence that the terminal is un-occluded and the input row clears the Scenario/Edit buttons — NEVER DOM counts (this is a visual/occlusion bug).
